name: PIG Build A Berm Self Rising Drive Over Barrier, Ideal For Long-Term Custom Containment, High-Traffic Areas, 7" x 9' x 4", Containment Berms & Barrie
description: Drive right into and out of your 4" tall Build-A-Berm containment area; when a spill strikes, this special barrier rises to the occasion. Berm wall lays flat to allow forklifts, pallet jacks and drum trucks to drive-over for easy access to containment area In the event of a spill, drive-over gate will automatically rise with the spill level to keep liquids contained Berm ends can be directly connected to an existing 4"H Build-A-Berm system Ends of 4"H berm are pliable, open-cell foam core covered with vinyl; gate section is constructed of durable PVC Secure to floor with sealant and reinforce with predrilled aluminum mounting strips and steel anchors; seal seams with vinyl cement
